sloka: स्वगात्राणि विनिक्षिप्य किं शेषे रुधिराप्लुतः ।प्रसुप्त इव शोकार्तां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे ।। ६.११४.८० ।।
transliteration: svagātrāṇi vinikṣipya kiṁ śeṣe rudhirāplutaḥ ।prasupta iva śokārtāṁ kiṁ māṁ na pratibhāṣase ।। 6.114.80 ।।

translations.english: "You did not take the advice of both Maricha and Kumbhakarna. You have also not taken the advice of my father because of the pride of your valour. This kind of result is the consequence of that."
